memoryBuilder.verseText: I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works.

sequence.prompt: What does God know about you? Put it in order.

items.label: God carefully made you before you were born
God knows every part of you
God sees you wherever you go
God loves you just as you are

matches.prompt: Match each to what God knows or made.

pairs.right: Knit together by God with great care
Written in God's book before you were born
Made on purpose, not by accident

application.question: God made every part of YOU on purpose and calls you wonderful! What is one thing about yourself that you are thankful God made?
application.followUp: God did not make you by mistake. He made every part of you carefully and lovingly — and He calls you wonderfully made. That is the truth about you.
